stops.name: Pinar de La Algaida
stops.detail: The area includes different species of plants, especially pine pineapple and with a thick bushes made up of pines, lentiks, bison and savines. A great variety of birds inhabit the environment, such as black storks, cranes, flaminks, squids and seals as well as a long list of insecticivorous birds. At its entrance you will also find the so-called Laguna de Tarelo, an anide place of numerous birds from the area. There's an area of seafood with saline farms. The pinar de la Algaida has been with its population since the early 19th century and contains a great colony of milanos.
